selection_scope.construction_rule: per scenario construct one reusable baseline plus three treatment trajectories

eligibility_rule: candidate is eligible under the unchanged frozen v1.0 context/mechanism contract
scenario_token and log_id are both absent from the permanent old-smoke blacklist
scenario has never contributed to prior R1 technical-smoke execution
scenario is reserved exclusively for fresh technical-smoke use
scenario is excluded from the formal R1 development roster
scenario is excluded from future R4 confirmation
all selection features are pre-treatment and outcome-blind
official nuPlan database, map, identity, route, traffic-light, and replay prerequisites are READY before selection
execution_fail_closed_rules: preflight schedule must equal exactly 48 calls
CoreConstructionBudget.claim must execute immediately before every construction
the first attempted call above 48 must raise before construction
partial or failed execution cannot be relabeled compliant
no actual selection or execution is authorized by this contract
